build_HYV3ForCausalLMNextN: build a HunyuanV3 NextN speculative decoding model with config and optional quantization
run_HYV3ModelNextN_forward: run the NextN model forward pass with input ids, positions, and forward batch
run_HYV3ForCausalLMNextN_forward: run the full causal LM forward pass to get logits for speculative decoding
